parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=2.2 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: TPS79333DBVR is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 2.2 µF, p.4), whereas AP2210K-3.3TRG1 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.025–15 Ω (p.22)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AP2210K-3.3TRG1 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS79333DBVR is rated to only 5.5 V rec. (6 V abs max, p.4) vs AP2210K-3.3TRG1 at 13.2 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS79333DBVR supplies up to 200 mA (p.5) compared to AP2210K-3.3TRG1 at 300 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP2210K-3.3TRG1: 250 mV p.11 vs TPS79333DBVR: 112 mV p.7); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS79333DBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6 V, p.4) than AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (15 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2210K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C ambient; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TPS79333DBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2210K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS79333DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because ceramic output capacitor ESR stability difference; Vin,max rating drops >=20%; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 51 °C on AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 200 °C/W) vs 46.5 °C on TPS79333DBVR (θJA 182.3 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 2.5x ratio (100 µA (p.11) vs 250 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2210K-3.3TRG1 "Pin 4 Is Active BYP (Internal Reference), NOT NC — CBYP Must Not Exceed 100 pF" (p.23) and TPS79333DBVR "CRITICAL Mixed Legacy (CSO:DLN) vs New Chip (CSO:RFB) Silicon Lottery on Non-M3 OPN" (p.28). BOM decision: Choose AP2210K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 200 mA (up to 300 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 100 µA Iq; choose TPS79333DBVR when your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors or low Vin-Vout headroom requires 112 mV dropout. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
